title: Implement campaign registry and picker (registry.json + campaigns CLI commands)
description: Per ADR 0004. Maintain <root>/registry.json (id, display name, db path, created/last-played timestamps, module/rules-pack identity; pointers only, no content/secrets; atomic temp+rename writes). When LOREWEAVER_DB_PATH is unset: 'new' creates campaigns/<slug>.db and registers it; 'play' with no arg uses empty->offer-create, single->open, multiple->picker honoring defaultCampaignId; add 'campaigns list|rename|remove|add <path>'. When LOREWEAVER_DB_PATH is set, bypass the registry entirely (ADR 0003 behavior preserved).
close_reason: Implemented and merged in PR #40 (ADR 0004 managed storage model).
